context.scope: Closed liquid cooling loop for electronic equipment; functional FMEA
assumptions: Generic equipment, not a specific NASA vehicle
No component reliability or thermal qualification data
requirement_refs: C1: remove equipment heat during operation

items.name: Heat exchanger
items.function: Reject coolant heat to the environment

description: A circulation pump moves coolant through a cold plate attached to electronic equipment, then through a heat exchanger and back to the pump. Flexible hoses connect the components. A single outlet-temperature sensor feeds a controller and display. The controller may increase pump speed when measured outlet temperature rises; no independent automatic equipment shutdown is specified. The surrounding air removes heat from the exchanger. Startup and steady equipment operation are in scope. Ambient conditions and heat load may vary, but numeric heat loads, temperature limits, minimum flow, coolant properties, maintenance history, sensor accuracy and failure-rate data are not supplied. Treat overheating, coolant containment, and misleading temperature information as engineering topics to analyze rather than supplied reference failure modes. Do not invent backup cooling paths.
